title: Robot Arena
build: cd showcase-app && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
card: Robots with one brain for life that learn while they fight: calm in routine, woken by surprise, kept in your browser from fight to fight.
tagline: Robots with one brain for life, fighting and learning live in your browser
kicker: CALM IN ROUTINE, LEARNING ON SURPRISE
feature: Each robot has one Cadence brain for life, with real memory and a real state, running live in your browser. Routine settles calmly; a surprise, or less pay than usual, wakes learning (amber). Each brain carries on from fight to fight.
howTo: Watch the halos: blue is calm, amber is learning. Click a robot to watch its brain settle and its synapses change. Speed up with as fast as they settle. After a fight, reload: the brains come back as you left them.
promise_test: cd robot-arena/showcase-app && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../.. && python robot-arena/tools/promise_arena.py --out <dir> --shots <dir>
